findings.message: Entry `Aurora Jumper` at `$['data']['hasPart'][1]` in `hasPart` carries no `@id`.
findings.remediation: Add `@id`, the exact `@id` string the member or parent declares in its own sheet. An entry that cannot name its target's identity does not belong in the array.
